ComponentDescription: Listens on the LOCAL MQTT broker for Matter control commands (rdk/matter/device/control), forwards them to the Matter hub CGI with axios (the transport proven against matterapi.ha), and publishes the outcome to rdk/matter/device/control/result. Cloud<->gateway relay handled by clientdevices.mqtt.Bridge, same as com.rdk.pathcontrol. Deps pinned for the gateway's Node 10 runtime.
